articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: What Catalysts Are Shifting The Narrative For General Electric (GE) Now. General Electric's implied fair value has been nudged higher, with the model's price target moving from US$339.69 to US$357.24 per share as analysts refresh their views on GE Aerospace. Behind this shift is a mix of more optimistic revenue assumptions and a slightly lower discount rate, informed by Street research that weighs both upside from a strong aerospace pipeline and the execution risks that could limit further re rating.
